scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && node scripts/python.mjs -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run migrate && concurrently -k -n assets,django "npm:dev:assets" "npm:dev:server"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && node scripts/python.mjs manage.py check && node scripts/python.mjs manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
